## KATSEYE Members Profile (2026)
Meet all 6 KATSEYE members Manon, Sophia, Daniela, Lara, Megan, and Yoonchae. Full profiles with ages, heights, nationalities, positions, and MBTI. KATSEYE is a six-member girl group created through the Dream Academy reality competition, a joint project between HYBE and Geffen Records. The group debuted on June 28, 2024 with their single “Touch” and almost immediately built a devoted global fanbase called Eyekons. What makes KATSEYE stand out is how genuinely diverse they are. The six members come from the United States, Switzerland, and South Korea, each bringing their own cultural background and personality to the group. Manon, Sophia, Daniela, Lara, Megan, and Yoonchae each have a unique story, and that’s exactly what we’re covering here. Read on for each member’s full profile, including their age, height, nationality, position, MBTI, and more. Manon’s full name is Meret Manon Sarpong Bannerman and she was born and raised in Zürich, Switzerland, which already makes her story pretty different from most K-pop idols. Her mom is Swiss-Italian and her dad is from Ghana, so she grew up with this beautiful blend of European and African heritage that you can genuinely feel when you watch her perform. Her first language is Swiss-German and she also speaks German, English, and a little French. On top of that she’s been learning Spanish from Daniela since they share a dorm room, which honestly says a lot about how close the members are with each other. Manon has been writing songs since she was literally five years old, which means music has always been part of who she is rather than something she stumbled into. She is a photography model as well, and her visuals have always been one of the most talked about things about her in the fanbase. Her nicknames among the members are “Manz” and “Manzanita” which fans find incredibly endearing. She is a huge Billie Eilish fan and her biggest role model is Beyoncé, which honestly makes a lot of sense when you see the elegance she brings to every stage. She loves traveling and always talks about wanting to teleport back home to Switzerland whenever she misses it. One fun fact that surprises a lot of fans is that she is allergic to strawberries. Her dream charm is the Stellar Tiara, which was chosen to represent the light of hope, royalty, and elegance. As of the time of writing, Manon is on a temporary hiatus from group activities to focus on her health and wellbeing, and the entire KATSEYE fandom has been sending her nothing but love and support during that time.
